out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FACILITY IS IN NEED OF AN EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY. EHS PROVIDED FFX COUNTY EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY FOR PIC TO MAKE COPIES AND HAVE ALL EMPLOYEES SIGN THE DOCUMENT.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE FAILING TO WASH HANDS BEFORE FOOD PREPARATION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC MADE EMPLOYEES THROW FOOD AWAY THEY HAD FAILED TO WASH THEIR HANDS BEFORE PREPPING AND THEN WASH THEIR HANDS.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE USING THEIR BARE HANDS TO HANDLE COOKED FOOD SUCH AS WHEN PORTIONING RICE AND WHEN CUTTING NAAN BREAD.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. . AFTER OBSERVING EMPLOYEE HANDLING PREPPED FOOD, PIC HAD EMPLOYEE THROW AWAY FOODS THAT WERE TOUCHED BY BARE HAND CONTACT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDSINK TO THE RIGHT OF THE ICE MACHINE BEING USED TO TO FILL BOWLS OF WATER FOR FOOD PREP AS WELL AS RINSING OFF UTENSILS IN BETWEEN USE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PLEASE MAKE SURE THAT ALL EMPLOYEES ONLY WASH THEIR HANDS AT HANDS SINKS. HAND SINKS ARE NOT TO BE USED FOR ANYTHING BESIDES WASHING HANDS. PIC MADE EMPLOYEES STOP USING HAND SINKS FOR THINGS OTHER THAN WASHING HANDS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED THE HAND WASHING SINK AT BAR, DID NOT HAVE A HAND WASH ONLY SIGN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE PROVIDE HAND WASH SIGNAGE AT ALL HAND SINKS BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: EHS OBSERVED RAW LIQUID EGGS AND RAW CHICKEN BEING STORED ABOVE AND NEXT TO READY TO EAT FOODS IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED RAW AND RTE ORGANIZATION WITH PIC. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REARRANGE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO MAKE SURE ALL RAW FOODS AND READY TO EAT FOODS WERE STORED CORRECTLY. MASTI INDIAN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/27/2026) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRIED SPINACH(74F) AND FRIED ONIONS(76F) WERE OUT OF TEMPERATURE AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES FOR TCS FOODS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE THROW AWAY FRIED SPINACH AND FRIED ONIONS AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: CHILI INFUSED OIL (11/5); COOKED MASALA SAUCE(5/20) ; TANDOORI SAUCE (5/20); AND COOKED CHICKEN (5/17) WERE ALL BEING STORED IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AFTER THE 7 DAYS ALLOWED FOR USE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS KEPT OVER 7 DAYS NEEDED TO BE THROWN AWAY AND CAN NOT BE USED. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE THROW AWAY ALL FOODS THAT WERE BEING KEPT LONGER THAN 7 DAYS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED MANGO LASSI IN BAR COOLER WITH NO DATE MARKING LABELED ON IT.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO LABEL ALL FOODS WITH THE DATE MARK OF WHEN THE FOOD WAS PREPARED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-First Aid Supplies Not Contained
violations.observation: First Aid Supplies are not being stored in a kit or container. OBSERVED FIRST AID KIT AND FIRST AID ITEMS BEING STORED WITH FOOD/DRY STOCK ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Store all first aid supplies in a kit or container that is located to preclude the accidental contamination of food, food equipment, and other food contact surfaces. PIC MOVED THE FIRST AID ITEMS TO THE STORAGE ROOM WHERE EMPLOYE PERSONAL ITEMS AND EMPLOYEE BATHROOM IS LOCATED.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED MULTIPLE CHEMICAL STORAGE CONTAINERS WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PLEASE ENSURE TO LABEL ALL CHEMICAL STORAGE CONTAINERS BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SQUEEZE BOTTLES, SEASONING SHAKERS AND SPARY BOTTLES WITHOUT CORRECT LABELS ON THEM ONCE THEY WERE TAKEN OUT OF THE ORIGINAL CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO LABEL ALL SQUEEZE BOTTLES, SEASONING SHAKERS AND SPARY BOTTLES BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED A GAP BETWEEN THE FLOOR AND THE BOTTOM OF THE DOOR LEADING TO THE EXTERIOR, IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN NEAR THE OFFICE.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PLEASE PROVIDE WEATHER STRIPPING FOR THE DOOR NEAR THE OFFICE IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. MULTIPLE FOOD ITEMS IN BOTH THE KITCHEN AND BAR WHERE BEING STORED ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO STORE ALL FOOD ITEMS AT A MINIMUM OF 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND. PLEASE STORE ALL FOODS 6 INCHES OR HIGHER BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. OBSERVED MULTIPLE EMPLOYEES WITHOUT A USING HAIR RESTRAINT.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL EMPLOYEES ARE WEARING A HAIR RESTRAINT AT ALL TIMES.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. OBSERVED MULTIPLE EMPLOYEES WEARING BRACELETS AND WATCHES AT TOME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL EMPLOYEES ARE NOT WEARING JEWELRY DURING THEIR SHIFT BESIDES PLAIN WEDDING BAND.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED SPOONS, SPATULAS AND TONGS ON BOTH THE STOVE TOP AND FLAT TOP IN KITCHEN BEING STORED IN WATER THAT WAS 99F, 98F AND 131F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO BE STORING IN USE UTENSILS AT AT LEAST 135F AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils were found stored ON THE FLOOR IN BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO KEEP ALL EQUIPMENT OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE SURE EQUIPMENT IS OFF THE FLOOR BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. MASTI INDIAN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/27/2026) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SEASONING CONTAINERS BEING USED TO STORE OTHER SEASONINGS THEN WHAT THEY ORIGINALLY INTENDED TO STORE.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE MAKE SURE NOT REFILL SEASONING CONTAINERS THAT ARE USED FOR ONE TIME USE. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO THROW AWAY CONTAINERS AND REPLACE WITH NEW.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. NO QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT WAS OBSERVED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE OBTAIN QUATERNARY AMMONIA KIT BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. MASTI INDIAN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/27/2026) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the MOP SINK is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. EHS PROVIDED CORRECT BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE NEEDED FOR MOP SINK. PIC UNSCREWED INCORRECT SPLITTER FROM MOP SINK FOR THE TIME BEING AND WILL ORDER A NEW SPLITTER BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PLEASE PROVIDE A TRASH CAN WITH A LID IN EMPLOYEE BATHROOM FOR FEMININE HYGIENE PRODUCTS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO STORE ALL MOPS SO THEY CAN PROPERLY DRY AND PREVENT THE POTENTIAL OF BACTERIA GROWTH. PLEASE MAKE TO STORE MOPS CORRECTLY BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED MULTIPLE HOLES AND GAPS IN THE CEILING THAT NEED TO BE FILLED OR REPAIRED.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO PATCH ALL HOLES AND GAPS IN THE CEILING BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
